en.title: A.J. Cook's Surprising Early Role Alongside Star Wars' Hayden Christensen
en.summary: Before becoming a fan-favorite BAU agent, A.J. Cook starred in a drama series that featured a young Hayden Christensen. Their characters navigated complex themes of addiction and trauma.
en.body:
Most fans know **A.J. Cook** as Jennifer "JJ" Jareau, the unwavering BAU agent from **Criminal Minds** who has navigated countless complex cases for two decades. However, before she was tracking unsub's with the Behavioral Analysis Unit, Cook had a breakout role in a TV drama that might surprise even the most dedicated viewers. Her early work placed her alongside a young **Hayden Christensen**, years before he donned Darth Vader's iconic helmet.

The series in question was **Higher Ground**, a short-lived drama that aired for a single season. In it, Cook played Shelby Merrick, a troubled teenager sent to Mount Horizon for drug-related issues. The show delved into the experiences of young people grappling with significant trauma and addiction. Shelby's storyline included a romantic entanglement with Scott Barringer, portrayed by Christensen. Barringer, a former football star, was also at Mount Horizon dealing with the aftermath of sexual abuse and subsequent drug abuse. The series tackled these heavy themes with a dramatic flair, giving both Cook and Christensen significant dramatic material to work with early in their careers.

## A Different Kind of Intensity

While **Criminal Minds** is known for its intense procedural elements and dark subject matter, **Higher Ground** explored a different, more personal kind of intensity. Cook's portrayal of Shelby offered a glimpse into her dramatic range, showcasing a vulnerability and depth that foreshadowed her later success. Christensen, meanwhile, was still developing his craft before his ascent to global superstardom. The pairing of Cook and Christensen in this drama offered a compelling dynamic, exploring the complexities of young lives impacted by difficult circumstances. The show's focus on character-driven narratives and the emotional toll of trauma provided a fertile ground for these emerging talents to hone their skills.

## Fan Connections and Forgotten Gems

For fans of **A.J. Cook**, discovering her earlier work like **Higher Ground** adds another layer to their appreciation of her career. It's a reminder that even established stars have formative roles that shape their journey. The fact that this breakout role also featured **Hayden Christensen**, a figure now synonymous with one of cinema's most iconic villains, only amplifies the interest. It’s a piece of television history that connects two beloved figures in unexpected ways, sparking conversations among fans about the early days of their favorite actors and the hidden gems of television past. Many viewers are likely revisiting or discovering this series for the first time, intrigued by this surprising link.

## What's Next

While **Higher Ground** concluded after its initial season, **A.J. Cook** has continued to captivate audiences on **Criminal Minds**, which recently saw a new season premiere. Fans can look forward to more of her compelling performances as JJ. Information regarding any potential future projects for **Hayden Christensen** beyond his established franchise roles has not yet been announced.
